## Slate overview
Week 6 Sunday (CIN, DET, MIA and MIN on bye). Lines and moves are from [Rotowire](https://www.rotowire.com/football/article/nfl-week-6-odds-biggest-line-moves-betting-splits-and-key-injuries-140948), sharp action from [Yahoo/BetMGM](https://sports.yahoo.com/nfl/betting/article/everything-to-know-for-betting-nfl-week-6-odds-sharp-action-public-betting-splits-and-big-bets-172246429.html), injuries from [CBS](https://www.cbssports.com/nfl/news/nfl-week-6-injury-report-lamar-jackson-jalen-hurts-caleb-williams/), and projections from [Covers AI](https://www.covers.com/nfl/ai-predictions-week-6-2026) and [SportsLine](https://www.cbssports.com/betting/news/nfl-odds-spreads-picks-predictions-lines-best-bets-week-6-2026/).

Big moves: HOU/JAX flipped to JAX -3. CAR/PHI went from PHI -1.5 to CAR -3.5 (Hurts OUT, McKee starts). TEN/IND went from IND -3.5 to -7. LAC/KC went from KC -2.5 to -7.5/-8.5. PIT/TB flipped to PIT -2.5/-3. NYJ/NE went from NE -10 to -7/-7.5. ARI/LAR went from LAR -14 to -12.5. BAL/CLE went from BAL -6.5 to -4.5 (Lamar OUT).

**Feedback loop:** we're 13-12 after a 3-0 Saturday. Calibration has improved to 52% actual vs. 56% predicted. Model disagreement is now 7-4, injury edge 6-2 and line moves 4-2. Every pick below has a sharp-money signal or a second model agreeing. Each is half a unit.

## Best bets
### Chargers +7.5 (-110; +8.5 where available) at Chiefs: 0.5 units
- **Win probability 56% vs. 52.4% implied.** Covers AI projects KC 24-17 and takes LAC +8.5. **Sharp money** is on Chargers +7.5 and the under.
- The line moved 5-6 points toward KC (from -2.5). We're taking the inflated number past the key number 7, the same setup as the Oct 11 Dolphins +7.5 win. The Chargers are without Alt, Derwin James and Donte Jackson. Herbert plays and McConkey is active. KC is without Rashee Rice and OT Josh Simmons.
- **Risk:** the Chargers' depleted offensive line against the KC pass rush.

### Cardinals +12.5 (-110) at Rams: 0.5 units
- **Win probability 56% vs. 52.4% implied.** Two models agree: SportsLine has ARI covering in "well over 50%" of simulations, and Covers AI projects LAR 30-20.
- The line has come down from 14 to 12.5. **Risk:** Arizona's RB Jeremiyah Love is OUT and Budda Baker is questionable.

### Buccaneers +3 (-110) vs. Steelers: 0.5 units
- **Win probability 55% vs. 52.4% implied.** **Sharp money** is on Bucs +3, and Covers AI projects PIT 21-20. Covers's AI, its computer model and its expert all take TB.
- Jalon Daniels beat Dallas last week in place of Mayfield. Pittsburgh is without WR Roman Wilson and S DeShon Elliott, and DK Metcalf (illness) and Jalen Ramsey are questionable. Tampa is without Winfield, and Morrison is doubtful.
- **Only at +3.** At +2.5, pass.

### Patriots -7 (-110) vs. Jets: 0.5 units
- **Win probability 56% vs. 52.4% implied.** Two models agree: SportsLine picks NE -7, and Covers AI projects NE 27-17.
- The line fell from -10 to -7, so we're buying the favorite at a better number. NE beat LV 45-17 last week, with Maye throwing 4 TDs. The Jets are without Breece Hall, Adonai Mitchell and OL Dylan Parham. A.J. Brown is questionable after coming off IR.
- **Risk:** the push at 7. Don't lay -7.5.

## Leans & passes
- **Browns +4.5:** pass. Sharps are on CLE, but the models split (Covers AI BAL 24-20, CBS AI BAL 23-16), and both teams are missing their QBs.
- **Falcons +1.5:** lean. Sharps and three Covers sources like ATL, but the projection (CHI by 1) leaves no edge at +1.5.
- **Giants +1.5:** pass. The models like NYG, but the line moved 4 points the other way.
- **Colts -7, Jaguars -3, Panthers -3.5:** pass. Those moves are already made.
- **Bills -5.5:** pass. Covers AI's top pick conflicts with sharp money on LV +5.5.
- **Packers -1.5:** pass. The projection margin (2) is too thin.
- **Totals:** pass (0-3 on unders).

## Risks
- Check inactives 90 minutes before kickoff: Metcalf, Ramsey, A.J. Brown and the Chargers' OL.
